name: Run notebooks batch
description: Non-interactive launcher that runs all Jupyter notebooks using the built repository image.

environment.name: Run notebooks batch
environment.description: External image environment based on the successful build; runs notebooks via the CNB lifecycle launcher.
args: set -euxo pipefail; cd /home/renku/work; echo 'Searching for notebooks...'; find . -path '*/.ipynb_checkpoints/*' -prune -o -name '*.ipynb' -print; find . -path '*/.ipynb_checkpoints/*' -prune -o -name '*.ipynb' -print0 | xargs -0 -r -n 1 jupyter nbconvert --to notebook --execute --inplace --ExecutePreprocessor.timeout=1200
